description: The monthly data indices Alion publishes from the live postings on employers' own career sites, each with a page per country, employer, technology or day: AI hiring, remote openness by country, every employer's hiring report (100+ open roles), hiring of the companies in the news, return to office, entry-level jobs, pay transparency, tech skills demand, hiring after a funding round, the weekly hiring pulse, visa sponsorship and ghost jobs. Without arguments: the list of indices with their newest headline. With index: the newest edition (or period=yyyy-mm) - its headline, key figures, findings, the raw data and the list of its slices; with slice: one country ("germany"), employer ("anthropic"), technology ("python") or day ("2026-11-12"). Every answer carries cite: the page's own dated sentence naming Alion, its frozen url and a sources-list line, CC BY 4.0. Free for everyone - no account, key or payment. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

index.description: The index code, e.g. "ai-hiring", "remote-openness", "company-hiring", "hiring-movers", "hiring-news", "return-to-office", "entry-level", "pay-transparency", "tech-skills", "funded-hiring", "hiring-pulse", "visa-sponsorship", "ghost-jobs". Omit for the list.

period.description: An edition month, yyyy-mm; the newest when omitted.

slice.description: One page of the edition: a country, employer, technology, stage or day, by slug or name ("germany", "anthropic", "c-sharp", "series-a", "2026-11-12").

name: get_index

cite.description: How to quote this answer in a text: the sentence, the page to link, the date. Absent on an error.

as_of.description: The day the figures are true for (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD)

license.description: The licence of the figures, when they may be reused

reference.description: The same as one line for a list of sources

text.description: A dated sentence with the figures of this answer, ready to quote as written

url.description: The public Alion page the figures stand on: link it where the sentence is used

indices.description: Without index: every index with its newest headline

slices.description: The pages of the edition: slice slug and label

stats.description: The key figures: value and label

title.description: The headline: the one finding, as a sentence
